answer: Vesting with clawback resists sybils: earned coin unlocks slowly like an incoming tide, not all at once, and only sustained honest conduct carries an account to full balance. A fake caught before its stake matures forfeits everything unvested — the slash claws it back like an onyx bead pulled off a string. A swarm of disposable accounts that grab nectar and vanish never reaches payout, so hit-and-run extraction simply stops paying.
